rows.attack-creates-one-knight-per-opponent: The Knight token IS created (count 1, asserted and passing) and its creation counts toward the Squadron's CDA (Squadron 2/2, correct), but the tapped-and-attacking Knight deals NO combat damage: p1 took 2 damage (18 life), not 3 -- the token never joined the attackers (CR 506.4, 510.1). Contrast: Adeline's attacking Human token DOES attack and deal damage in this family, so the mechanism exists and Silverwing's token registration path is the odd one out.
rows.vigilance-attacker-untapped-and-pt-grows: The CDA reading is CORRECT: with the created Knight token the Squadron counts 4 creatures you control and reads 4/4 (CR 604.3) -- the round-1 defect row that claimed 'the Knight does not count toward the CDA here' was withdrawn after re-counting (its 5/5 want needed 5 creatures that do not exist). The only real divergence is the one the lone-Squadron scenario already records: the tapped-and-attacking Knight deals no combat damage, so p1 took 4 (16 life) instead of 6 (14 life).
